Nothing else I ran touched the network.

**Commits**
- `f378ba5f` owner bench: headless runner (run.mjs) with credit budget, resume and dry run. It adds `run.mjs`, `run.test.mjs` and a README section.
- `0c9bf7c9` owner bench: review sheet and lower-only score adjustments (review.mjs). It adds `review.mjs` and `review.test.mjs`.

**Tests:** 27 pass, 0 fail (19 in `run.test.mjs`, 8 in `review.test.mjs`).
- They use only a fake worker, fake socket and fake clock, with no network and no secrets.
- Run them with `cd packages/evals && node --test owner-bench/run.test.mjs owner-bench/review.test.mjs`.
- `node scripts/clean-test-tmp.mjs` was run afterwards.
- `--dry-run` was checked by hand against the real `requests.json`: it printed the plan, made no network call and wrote nothing.

**Uncommitted score.mjs.** The tests that check my output against `score.mjs` only run when `score.mjs` is present. In this worktree it is not (it is untracked in the main checkout). I ran those checks once with a temporary copy, and they passed (27 of 27 either way). I then deleted the copy and did not commit it.

**What `run.mjs` does** (`packages/evals/owner-bench/run.mjs`)
- It follows the `runner.js` protocol and keeps its fixes: 25-minute turn cap then `POST /stop`, a 15s retry on 409 "a run is in progress" for up to 10 minutes on reset and evaluate, and credits counted after evaluate.
- **Flags:** `--project`, `--bank`, `--run`, `--from`, `--only`, `--ids`, `--max-credits`, `--redo`, `--dry-run`, `--base`.
- **Sign-in:** it uses `GOLEM_BENCH_JWT` plus `GOLEM_BENCH_REFRESH_TOKEN`, or `GOLEM_E2E_EMAIL` plus `GOLEM_E2E_PASSWORD`. It refreshes the token and retries once on a 401. Errors never include secrets.
- **Budget:** `--max-credits` counts everything already in the results file, so a resumed run cannot overspend. It is checked before each item starts; an item already running can still overshoot.
- **Results:** `results/<run>.json` is a plain array, written after each step and resumable with the same `--run`. Photos are saved at once to `results/<run>/<id>/<angle>.png`, because the server keeps them for only one hour.
- **Resume:** `done` rows are skipped. An errored or unjudged row runs again and keeps its earlier credits in the total.
- **Refused changes:** a `done` item whose request text has changed in the bank is refused.
- **Early stop:** a quota stop, `account_not_approved` or `studio_required` ends the run without calling the paid evaluate.
- **Preflight:** a project with no `bench-baseline` checkpoint stops before anything is spent.

**What `review.mjs` does** (`packages/evals/owner-bench/review.mjs`)
- `sheet <results.json>` writes `results/<run>/review.md` with each item's request, scores, critique, census, play test, problems and absolute photo paths. It downloads only the photos that are missing, and does not sign in if they are all on disk.
- `apply <results.json> <adjustments.json> [--dry-run] [--out f]` accepts only `[{id, scores:{criterion: 0..2}, reason}]`.
  - A score is lowered only if the new value is below the current one, and a non-blank reason is required.
  - Anything else is reported and ignored.
  - The row keeps `originalScores`, `originalTotal` and an `adjustments` list, and its `total` is recomputed.

**Left alone:** `packages/evals/package.json` still has no `owner-bench/*.test.mjs` glob in this branch. Your main checkout has that change uncommitted, and I did not want a merge conflict.

**Not measured:** the real worker was never run through this, so the behaviour against it, including evaluate's duration and cost, is untested.

Verdict: the commits are sound and safe to merge. Every point passes, with four minor gaps. I made no network calls; my probe used an injected fake `api`, `WebSocketImpl` and `fetch`. The worktree is still clean.

Worktree: `/Users/moshe/Developer/RbxAI/.claude/worktrees/wf_3d85181d-498-2`, files in `packages/evals/owner-bench/`.

**Tests: PASS.** 27 of 27 pass (19 in `run.test.mjs`, 8 in `review.test.mjs`) in about 200 ms. `scripts/clean-test-tmp.mjs` was run afterwards.

**Protocol fidelity with `runner.js`: PASS.**
- The worktree's `runner.js` is the older version, because base 76c30935 predates fix commit 4d8cb2c2. That commit is in the main checkout and sets a 25-minute cap, `POST /stop` on timeout, `whenIdle` on reset and evaluate, and credits counted after evaluate.
- I compared `run.mjs` with the fixed main-checkout `runner.js`, and they match.
- Reset comes before restore (`run.mjs` lines 281-286).
- A reset that returns `ok` other than true throws before restore, any turn or any spend.
- The turn cap is 25 minutes, then `/stop` is called (line 297).
- Reset and evaluate retry every 15 s on 409 with `error === 'a run is in progress'`, for up to 10 minutes. That string matches `apps/worker/src/do/session.ts:2663` and `:2683`.
- Credits are tallied after evaluate. The `/messages` call is last, and the test asserts the call order.
- `/bench-reset` deletes the messages table (session.ts ~2667), so each tally covers one item.
- `run.mjs` writes `seconds`, which `score.mjs` reads; `runner.js` wrote `ms`.

**Secrets: PASS.**
- The only `process.env` reads are the sign-in variables, `API_BASE` and the secrets list. Nothing prints an env value.
- Errors from the sign-in state only the HTTP status. The row error is scrubbed and the CLI top-level prints only `e.message`.
- The tests check that no secret appears in the log or results file.
- The commits contain no token-like strings (grep for `eyJ`, `sb_secret`, `service_role`, a hard-coded anon key).
- Gap: `packages/evals/owner-bench/results/` is not gitignored. A careless `git add` could commit photos and results, though not secrets. Only `.env` is ignored.

**`--max-credits` stops before an item starts: PASS.**
- The check is at line 275, before the row is created and before reset, and it uses `spentOf(rows)`, which includes rows already in the file.
- The test shows a1 then a2 run (15 credits against a budget of 10) and a3 is refused.
- A resumed file with a bigger budget runs only a3. With nothing left to run, the budget is never hit.
- The overshoot by an item already running is documented.

**Resumability: PASS.**
- The results file is written through a temp file and `rename` after each step.
- `done` rows are skipped. Error and unjudged rows rerun and keep their earlier credits (4 before plus 5 now gives 9).
- A `done` item whose request text changed is refused unless `--redo` is given.
- Gap 1: nothing handles SIGINT or SIGTERM. Ctrl-C mid-item leaves the server run going and spending credits, with no `/stop` sent. The browser runner behaved the same way.
- Gap 2: a hard kill mid-item leaves a `running` row at its pre-attempt credits. That attempt's spend is never counted, because the next reset wipes the messages. The budget can then undercount by up to one item.

**Credit accounting when reset never succeeds: minor bug, measured.**
- My probe made item b's reset fail on every retry. No turn ran for b, but b was recorded with `credits: 5`. That was a's leftover messages, read by the tally.
- This overcounts, which fails safe for the budget, but it makes the per-item numbers wrong.
- Fix: skip the tally when `row.reset` is not true.

**`review.mjs` can only lower scores: PASS.**
- `applyAdjustments` ignores an adjustment with a blank reason, an unknown id, an unjudged item, or no scores object.
- It ignores a criterion not in `CRITERIA`, which also blocks `__proto__`, a value that is not an integer 0 to 2, and `to >= from`.
- Only a strictly lower value is written.
- `originalScores` and `originalTotal` are set once (`??=`), an `adjustments` list is kept, and the total is recomputed.
- `apply` makes no network call, and `--dry-run` writes nothing.
- `sheet` signs in only when a photo is missing.
- Caveat: `run.mjs --redo` replaces the whole row, so earlier adjustments on that item are lost. Without `--redo` the `done` rows are skipped, so adjustments survive.

**Merge note:** the commits don't touch `runner.js`, so there is no overlap with 4d8cb2c2. The uncommitted `packages/evals/package.json` change in the main checkout is also untouched.

## Recap
- **Milestone:** none, ad-hoc work (STATE.md not consulted)
- **Phase:** n/a
- **Stage:** verifying
- **Why:** the owner wants more benchmark capacity without spending credits
- **Building:** a review of the headless owner-bench runner, `run.mjs`, and the review tool, `review.mjs`
- **Next:** the parent workflow merges `f378ba5f` and `0c9bf7c9`, and may ask for the small fixes above (skip the tally when reset fails, add a SIGINT handler that calls `/stop`, gitignore `results/`). Any live run waits for the owner's approval.
